    Nilpotence of the radical of a representation-finite module category #

    The biproduct of the chosen indecomposable representatives is a finite additive generator of FGModuleCat Aᵐᵒᵖ. Its endomorphism ring is finite-dimensional over the coefficient field and hence Artinian. The generic finite-generator theorem therefore supplies the canonical nilpotent categorical radical required by the tau-category interface.
